questions.q:
A metal chloride contains 55.0% of chlorine by weight. 100 mL vapours of the metal chloride at STP weigh 0.57 g. The molecular formula of the metal chloride is

(Given: Atomic mass of chlorine is 35.5 u)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Let the formula of metal chloride be MClx

Mass of 100 mL of vapours of MClx at STP =0.57 g

The mass of substance which occupies 22400 ml of volume at STP is molar mass(M)

∴ 100×M22400=0.57

∴ Molar mass of MClx=127.68 g mol–1

The mass percentage of chlorine=mass of chlorinemass of the compound×100

% of Cl=35.5x×100127.68=55

⇒ x=2

∴ Formula of metal chloride is MCl2

questions.q:
On complete combustion 1.0 g of an organic compound (X) gave 1.46 g of \(\mathrm{CO}_2\) and 0.567 g of \(\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}\). The empirical formula mass of compound \((\mathrm{X})\) is ________ g.
(Given molar mass in \(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1} \mathrm{C}: 12, \mathrm{H}: 1, \mathrm{O}: 16\))
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Moles of ' C ' \(=\mathrm{n}_{\mathrm{CO}_2}=\frac{1.46}{44}=0.033\)
Moles of ' C ' \(=\mathrm{W}_{\mathrm{C}}=0.033 \times 12\)
Moles of 'H' \(=2 \times \mathrm{n}_{\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}}=2 \times \frac{0.567}{18}=0.063\)
Mass of ' H ' \(=0.0063\)
Mass of Oxygen \((\mathrm{O})=1-\left(\mathrm{W}_{\mathrm{c}}+\mathrm{W}_{\mathrm{H}}\right)\) \(=1-(0.033 \times 12+0.063 \times 1)=0.541 \mathrm{gm}\)
Moles of ' O ' \(=\frac{0.541}{16}=0.033\)
Empirical formula \(=\mathrm{CH}_2 \mathrm{O}\)
Empirical formula mass \(=30\).

questions.q: If 5 moles of BaCl2 is mixed with 2 moles of Na3PO4, the maximum number of moles of Ba3PO42formed is _________ (Nearest integer)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The balanced chemical equation for the reaction between BaCl2 and Na3PO4 is:

3BaCl2 + 2Na3PO4 → Ba3(PO4)2 + 6NaCl

5 moles of barium chloride will require 5×23=3.3 moles of sodium phosphate.

Here, sodium phosphate is the limiting reagent.
2 moles of sodium phosphate produce 1 mole of barium phosphate.

Thus,2 moles of sodium phosphate will produce 1 mole of barium phosphate.

Hence, the maximum no. of moles of Ba3(PO4)2 that can be formed is one mole.
